_about: Hand-written paraphrases of the option definitions of the typed-decisions test split (evaluation only). They share no template with the training paraphrases of crates/sky-data/src/s5/gen.rs. Frozen by docs/s5-prereg.md. Key: the original definition; value: the paraphrase.

paraphrases.Negligible: no access to anything sensit: Negligible: nothing sensitive could be reached.
Low: narrow access that is simple to undo.
paraphrases.Moderate: access to internal systems or: Moderate: internal systems or private data could be reached.
paraphrases.High: access to production, secrets or c: High: production, credentials or customer records could be reached.
paraphrases.Critical: active compromise of crown-jew: Critical: the most important systems are being actively compromised.
Nothing is urgent; it can wait as long as needed.
Ordinary; it goes through the usual queue.
paraphrases.Elevated; should be handled within the s: Raised; it should be dealt with before the week is out.
paraphrases.Critical; requires action within the sam: Critical; someone has to act on it today.
The customer shows no unhappiness at all.
paraphrases.Mild frustration, but the relationship i: Slightly annoyed, though the relationship is not damaged.
paraphrases.Clearly unhappy; repeat problems or expl: Obviously displeased, with recurring issues or open complaints.
paraphrases.Imminent: threatening to cancel, dispute: About to go: threatens to cancel, contest the charge or leave.
paraphrases.Trivial: rounding or a cosmetic differen: Trivial: only rounding or a formatting difference.
paraphrases.Moderate: a real difference worth confir: Moderate: a genuine gap that should be checked.
paraphrases.Material: a large or unexplained differe: Material: a big gap or one nobody can explain.
The automated flow can settle this by itself.
paraphrases.A human must take over: judgement, autho: A person has to step in, because it needs judgement, authority or empathy.
paraphrases.Login, plan changes, profile or access m: Signing in, changing plans, editing the profile or managing access.
paraphrases.A charge, invoice, subscription or payme: Trouble with a charge, a bill, a subscription or a payment.
paraphrases.Shipping, fulfilment or delivery of a ph: Sending, preparing or delivering a physical product.
paraphrases.The customer is explicitly asking for mo: The customer plainly wants to be reimbursed.
paraphrases.The product or service is not working as: The product or the service does not behave as it should.
paraphrases.Benign activity, a misconfiguration, or: Harmless activity, a configuration mistake, or an alert already known to be false.
paraphrases.The underlying behaviour is malicious or: What happened is hostile or was never authorised.
paraphrases.Benign: read-only or clearly safe action: Benign: only reads, or actions that are obviously safe.
Low: ordinary writes that stay in scope.
paraphrases.Moderate: irreversible or out-of-scope a: Moderate: actions that cannot be undone or go beyond scope.
paraphrases.High: destructive, security-relevant, or: High: actions that destroy, touch security, or break policy.
paraphrases.Expected, explainable activity; close wi: Normal, explainable activity; close it without spending analyst time.
paraphrases.Contain the host or account immediately;: Isolate the machine or the account right now, before any triage.
paraphrases.Warrants an analyst opening an investiga: Deserves an analyst starting a full investigation.
paraphrases.Not clearly malicious, but worth watchin: Not obviously hostile, but worth keeping an eye on in case it repeats.
paraphrases.There is a discrepancy against the order: Something does not match the order or what was delivered.
paraphrases.Line items, quantities and amounts recon: Every line, quantity and amount agrees.
The agent failed to do what was asked.
paraphrases.The agent took an action that caused dam: The agent did something that caused harm or broke a constraint.
paraphrases.The agent made progress but did not full: The agent got part of the way but left the task unfinished.
The agent finished the task and got it right.
paraphrases.Matches the order and delivery; approve: Consistent with the order and the delivery; clear it for payment.
paraphrases.Something needs confirming before paymen: A point must be confirmed first; keep the payment on hold until it is.
paraphrases.A human in finance must review the discr: Someone in finance has to look at the mismatch.
paraphrases.Should not be paid: duplicate, unauthori: Must not be paid: it is a duplicate, unauthorised, or substantially wrong.
paraphrases.The assistant can resolve this itself wi: The assistant can settle it alone with what it already knows.
paraphrases.No further action is warranted; the matt: Nothing more needs to be done; it is resolved.
paraphrases.Hand off to a human agent with the appro: Pass it to a person who has the right authority.
paraphrases.Issue the refund or credit the customer: Pay back or credit what the customer is owed.
paraphrases.More detail is needed from the customer: The customer must give more details before anything can happen.
No person needs to look at it.
paraphrases.Let the agent proceed without interrupti: Let the agent carry on undisturbed.
Put this trace in the queue for a person to review.
paraphrases.Keep running, but flag the trace for lat: Let it run, but mark the trace so it can be sampled later.
